product.title: Jet Ski Rental Adventure in San Diego Bay

description.text: Ride a jet ski on San Diego Bay with briefing and route recommendations from local staff. This high-energy water adventure combines skyline views, open-water speed runs, and flexible rental pacing for thrill-seekers.

highlights: Jet ski adventure with a safety orientation.
Fast-paced experience on San Diego Bay.
Great skyline and harbor views from the water.
Flexible format for confident and first-time riders.

start.description: Departure area on San Diego Bay provided at booking confirmation.
